summary.executiveSummaryReference: The brewery team agreed a two-week production plan around fermenter availability, with a 1,200-litre pale ale batch followed by a 1,200-litre IPA batch. They confirmed hop and malt ordering needs, corrected the festival order from kegs to 15 nine-gallon casks and identified glycol chiller servicing as a critical dependency before the IPA brew. Clear actions were assigned to Ravi, Dan, Josie and Mick.
